remarks: Nature, grape vineyards, scenic views, woods to roam, creek, pond, artesian spring and 2 gas wells are all inclusive with this Town of Westfield land offering!!! This 100 acre parcel has a road cut in that goes up it's hill and offers a mesmerizing view of the countryside from hilltop and a far view of Lake Erie! So much you can do here...the vineyards at the road bring in income that cover the property taxes plus some....if building is in your future, the gas wells allow for free gas to the home when built. There is good water on the land, the spring can supply a new home, cabin or building needing water. Approx. 40 acres of grapes, 17 acres of timber, and water features include creek and pond! Build your dream home or use for weekend retreat, camping, hunting, any type of recreation that is your choice. Beautiful area in the heart of Chautauqua County!!
